sources.title: Novo Nordisk Confirms Cyber Attack — Hackers Accessed Patient Medical ...
sources.snippet: Danish pharmaceutical giant Novo Nordisk has confirmed a cyberattack in which threat actors gained unauthorized access to internal IT systems, exfiltrating pseudonymized patient data from clinical trials and, according to the alleged attackers, a trove of proprietary AI model assets.

sources.title: Novo Nordisk Breach Exposes AI Models and Patient Data
sources.snippet: Hackers breached Novo Nordisk, stealing AI training data, model checkpoints, and pseudonymized clinical trial patient records, now held for ransom.
